product_overview: Survey Storytelling is a static, interactive dashboard for university satisfaction surveys. It transforms Zoho Survey CSV exports into executive, operational, detailed, and qualitative views for exploring KPIs, distributions, filters, and comments.
core_goals: Review high-level satisfaction KPIs such as NPS and CSAT
Explore satisfaction distributions and operational dimensions by category
Drill into detailed satisfaction results by faculty, career, and academic cycle
Analyze qualitative comments by sentiment, category, and keyword
Export qualitative analysis data for offline use

features.name: Dashboard KPI Cards
features.description: Presenta indicadores clave de satisfacción para una vista ejecutiva rápida.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View NPS score, CSAT percentage, and promoter/passive/detractor counts

features.name: NPS Distribution Bar
features.description: Muestra la distribución de respuestas NPS en segmentos interactivos.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Hover over a distribution segment -> See counts and percentages for promoters, passives, or detractors

features.name: CSAT Distribution Bar
features.description: Muestra la distribución de satisfacción CSAT en cinco niveles.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Hover over a satisfaction segment -> See the detailed breakdown table for that level

features.name: Filters (Faculty, Career, Cycle)
features.description: Permite refinar todo el dashboard mediante filtros en cascada por facultad, carrera y ciclo académico.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select a faculty -> See all charts update to the chosen faculty
Navigate to / -> Select a faculty -> Select a career -> See the data narrow to that career within the selected faculty
Navigate to / -> Select a faculty -> Select a career -> Select a cycle -> See the data narrow to that academic period
Navigate to / -> Select filter reset -> See all data again

features.name: Radar Chart
features.description: Visualiza dimensiones de satisfacción en un gráfico radar interactivo con filtrado por categoría.
user_flows: Navigate to /#operativo -> Hover over a dimension label or data point -> See the satisfaction breakdown for that dimension
Navigate to /#operativo -> Select categories from the multiselect dropdown -> See the radar chart update to the chosen categories

features.name: Detailed Satisfaction Table
features.description: Presenta una tabla de resultados de satisfacción por facultad, carrera y ciclo con métricas resumidas y distribuciones.
user_flows: Navigate to /#detallado -> View T2B, T3B, and weighted average values across dimensions
Navigate to /#detallado -> Hover over a distribution bar -> See the per-level distribution details

features.name: Sentiment Analysis Dashboard
features.description: Resume el análisis cualitativo de comentarios con sentimiento, categorías y aspectos destacados.
user_flows: Navigate to /#cualitativo -> View positive, neutral, and negative sentiment distribution
Navigate to /#cualitativo -> View promoter, passive, and detractor segment bars
Navigate to /#cualitativo -> View top categories with stacked bars
Navigate to /#cualitativo -> View positive and negative aspect lists
Navigate to /#cualitativo -> Hover over a bar -> See the table-format tooltip details

features.name: Comment Explorer
features.description: Explora comentarios paginados con búsqueda y filtros por categoría y sentimiento.
user_flows: Navigate to /#cualitativo -> Search comments by keyword -> See matching comments
Navigate to /#cualitativo -> Filter by category and sentiment -> See the comment list narrow to the selected criteria
Navigate to /#cualitativo -> Click a sentiment legend item -> See comments filtered by that sentiment
Navigate to /#cualitativo -> Move through pages -> See additional comments

features.name: CSV Export
features.description: Descarga un ZIP con los datos de comentarios y respuestas por dimensión para análisis externo.
user_flows: Navigate to /#cualitativo -> Trigger export -> Download the ZIP file containing qualitative analysis CSV data

routes.description: Dashboard principal - sección Ejecutivo (KPIs, NPS, CSAT)
Dashboard sección Operativo (radar chart, top3 bars, insights)
Dashboard sección Detallado (tabla de preguntas, detalle carreras, visibilidad)
Dashboard sección Cualitativo (análisis de sentimiento y comentarios)

known_limitations.issue: Datos estáticos desde JSON, no hay backend en tiempo real
known_limitations.impact: Los datos solo se actualizan cuando se regeneran los JSONs mediante el ETL

known_limitations.issue: El ZIP de exportación solo existe si el ETL se ha ejecutado correctamente
known_limitations.impact: La descarga puede fallar si no se ha generado el ZIP en el build
